## Security verdict: PASS

PR #217 at **c34b14bf2050aa479ab1423c9226728c938acc7b**, under C33/C34. One bounded round: all six changed files, +9/-5, descriptions and documentation only.

- Both native tool descriptions contain the identical closing-block sentence; the FYI action rule is unchanged (`.copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs:93`; `.omp/extensions/pij/index.ts:92`).
- Peer, prime and PA pointers resolve to the existing Closing commands section (`skills/pij/references/routes/peer.md:81`; `routes/prime.md:61`; `prime/pa.md:94`).
- The block guidance matches its producers: send bodies are inline/quoted, output file bodies are permitted but stdin is not, and self-send refuses (`crates/daemon/src/http/turn_end.rs:197`; `http/output.rs:163`; `crates/core/src/delivery.rs:383`).
- The long-packet exception preserves pointer delivery (`skills/pij/SKILL.md:98-105`). `--body-file` exists on CLI send (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:392`), not either native `pij_send` schema. The text is compatible with a CLI tool call; it does not add or promise a native parameter.
- No added sensitive literals or executable interpolation were identified. The block tokenizer performs no expansion, and the guide explicitly says Copilot keeps the block visible.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in scoped changes | - |

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN and all five checks successful. Run [42757918505](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42757918505) checked merge `df029ecfb35824123601ccd3b23ddcc7314929dc`, whose parents are main `516d7961cf13e85879d20112fca720843fb31b2c` and this exact head. Node 22 logs show `pij-skill-check: all green`, 2,281 tests passed/6 skipped, and native extension tests 347 passed/zero failed.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, commands under review, config/credential reads, live probes or product mutations. No broader endpoint or performance re-audit.
